# CoreAI

> CoreAI is a free, intelligent AI assistant for chat, homework help, image generation, voice, and coding — built for English and Hindi speakers.

CoreAI is a web/PWA AI companion that combines smart conversational chat, AI image generation, voice transcription and text-to-speech, specialised modes (Food Recipe, Homework Helper, Code Assistant, Deep Research), and group chats. It runs free with no API keys required from users.
